I demand justice for #JacobBlake. I stand with those who demand the same. Arrest the police who shot an unarmed black man 7 times in the back while his children looked on.
#NoJusticeNoPeace #BlackLivesMatter

My heart goes out to the Black and #BLM community in Kenosha today, what has happened as a result of white supremacy and privilege is inhuman and devestating. To the two men lost, Rest in Power, to those protesting, make good trouble
#KenoshaShooting #KenoshaProtests
